title: Wayfair among firms fined millions for misleading sales tactics
summary:

The online furniture retailer was fined £4.8m for misleading customers with time-limited offers, while online electronics seller Appliances Direct was fined £1.2m for the same practice, the Competition Markets Authority (CMA) said.
Meanwhile, Gold's Gym has been fined £45,000 for not telling customers the total price of its memberships.

title: Federal watchdog says 9 large US banks denied service to customers over political or religious views
summary:

The federal banking watchdog determined that the banks' sweeping internal guidelines lacked objective, risk-based criteria, effectively shutting out legitimate customers and businesses based on ideological leanings rather than financial risk.
